name: GrowGanic AI SEO Blog Writer
author: growganic

sections.description:
GrowGanic is an autonomous SEO writer for WordPress. It finds the searches your site can actually win, then researches, writes and publishes cited, well structured articles to your blog, up to 30 a month. You approve the connection once and do nothing after that.

What you get

  • Topics you can win. GrowGanic reads your site and your market, then picks searches where your site has a real chance to rank, not the ones the biggest sites own.
  • Researched, cited articles. Every article is built from real sources it found and checked, with the citations kept in the article.
  • Published for you. Articles go live on your own blog as normal WordPress posts, with your categories, headings, FAQ and a featured image.
  • In your language. Articles are written in the language your site is written in.
  • Ranking reports. GrowGanic tracks where each article ranks on Google and shows you what is moving.
  • Your site, your content. Every article is a normal post you own. Disconnect any time and everything already published stays.

How it works

  1. Install this plugin and open GrowGanic in your admin menu.
  2. Click Connect GrowGanic and create your free account. Your site address is filled in for you.
  3. Approve the connection on the WordPress screen that opens. WordPress creates a private application password for GrowGanic; your login password is never shared.
  4. Your first article is written and published in a few minutes. It is free, no card needed.

The plugin shows the connection, the latest articles GrowGanic published, and lets you disconnect with one click.

Plans

The first article is free. Pro is $99 a month for one site and up to 30 articles a month. Business is $299 a month for up to 10 sites and 150 articles a month, built for agencies. Prices and current offers are on growganic.io/pricing.

External services

This plugin is an interface to GrowGanic (https://growganic.io), a service run by CERION SRLS. The plugin itself sends no data anywhere: it shows a link to growganic.io and reads the connection WordPress stores on your own site.

When you choose to connect, you go to growganic.io in your browser and approve the connection inside your own WordPress admin. From then on GrowGanic uses WordPress’s built in REST API, through the application password you approved, to create posts, upload featured images and read your categories and tags. It also reads your public pages to understand your business and plan topics.

  • Terms of Service: https://growganic.io/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://growganic.io/privacy
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes, a free GrowGanic account. The Connect button takes you to growganic.io with your site address filled in. The first article is free, no card needed.

Does GrowGanic get my WordPress password?

No. WordPress core creates a separate application password for GrowGanic when you approve the connection. You can revoke it from this plugin or from your user profile at any time.

Will articles publish without my review?

By default articles are published so your blog grows on autopilot. You can switch GrowGanic to drafts in your GrowGanic settings and publish them yourself.

What happens if I disconnect?

GrowGanic stops publishing. Every article already on your site stays exactly where it is.

Does it work with my SEO plugin?

Yes. Articles are normal posts, so Yoast SEO, Rank Math and other SEO plugins work with them as usual.

My site says application passwords are unavailable.

WordPress turns application passwords on only over HTTPS, and some security plugins switch them off. Enable HTTPS, or allow application passwords in your security plugin, then connect again.
